tenderSchedule.title: Organizing Children Dasara committee programs within the jurisdiction of the Shivamogga City Corporation on the occasion of the state festival Dasara 2026
tenderSchedule.description: Organizing Children Dasara committee programs within the jurisdiction of the Shivamogga City Corporation on the occasion of the state festival Dasara 2026

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All terms and conditions are as per the bid document

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Bidder should have valid Class-3 and above Electrical Contractor License issued from Inspectorate of Electricity/Class 4 and above PWD Civil Contractor License issued from PWD Karnataka

Tenderer in its name should submit annual turnover certificate any two years from last five years 2021-22 to 2025-26 of Rs.5.59 Lakhs in each year. Turn over certificate should be mandatorily certified from charted accountant and mention UDIN number is compulsory, otherwise it will be subjected to rejection

Tenderer should have at least Executed and Satisfactorily completed as prime contractor, at least one Similar work such as Conducting / carrying out various events of Makkala Dasara or Dasara festival in any Govt. Agency/ULBs/PSU in Last Five Years i.e. 2021-22 to 2025-26. The work done certificate submitted should be signed not less than rank of Executive Engineer and also mention the E-procurement indent number
The bidder should submit the GST/PAN Registration Certificate.
